title: Path traversal / arbitrary out-of-directory file read via sharded-checkpoint `weight_map` in `_get_checkpoint_shard_files`
author: geo-chen

comments.author: buffett0323
comments.body:
Hi! I'd like to take this one. 
I plan to sanitize the shard filenames in `_get_checkpoint_shard_files` by rejecting any weight_map value that is absolute or not equal to `os.path.basename(f)` (which blocks .. traversal), and also applying the guard to both the local/DDUF and Hub branches. Lastly, I'll add a regression test to cover the ../ and absolute-path PoCs. 

Thanks!

comments.author: sayakpaul
comments.body: Thanks for reporting and sorry for the delay that this got slipped.
